query: SELECT json_build_object('id',a.id,'type',a.type,'status',a.status,'topicLinks',(SELECT count(*) FROM activity_topics WHERE activity_id=a.id),'studentActivities',(SELECT count(*) FROM student_activities WHERE activity_id=a.id),'expected',(SELECT count(*) FROM student_activities WHERE activity_id=a.id AND is_expected),'attempts',(SELECT count(*) FROM attempts WHERE activity_id=a.id),'submittedAttempts',(SELECT count(*) FROM attempts WHERE activity_id=a.id AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL),'grades',(SELECT count(*) FROM attempt_grades WHERE activity_id=a.id),'publishedGrades',(SELECT count(*) FROM attempt_grades WHERE activity_id=a.id AND is_published),'finalGrade',(SELECT final_grade::text FROM attempt_grades WHERE activity_id=a.id AND is_published),'firstSubmittedLate',(SELECT submitted_late FROM attempts WHERE activity_id=a.id AND submitted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY attempt_number LIMIT 1),'notifications',(SELECT json_object_agg(event_type,n) FROM (SELECT event_type,count(*) n FROM notifications WHERE activity_id=a.id GROUP BY event_type) events)) FROM activities a WHERE a.id='78ed3f1f-14d2-497e-94c8-64d6adf98ad8';
